body.statement: Let \(R\) be a real closed field, let \(D_0\subseteq R\) be an ordered coefficient domain, and let \(\Phi(Y)\) be a first-order formula in the language of ordered fields whose atoms use finitely many polynomials in \(D_0[X,Y]\). There is an exact algorithm, using arithmetic and sign determination in \(D_0\), which produces a quantifier-free Boolean combination of polynomial sign conditions in the free variables \(Y\) that is equivalent to \(\Phi(Y)\) over \(R\).

source.verbatim_statement: In this paper, a new algorithm for performing quantifier elimination from first order formulas over real closed fields is given.
